types.name: component_of
types.title: component of
types.body: The source PhysicalComponent is a part of the target Product or PhysicalComponent (an assembly). Follow it down from a product to list what it is made of; quantities and costs belong to the revision that chooses them, not to this structural link.

types.name: includes_component
types.title: includes component
types.body: The source ProductRevision is built from the target PhysicalComponent. A hardware revision names the exact parts it pins, the way a software revision pins a commit; a later revision that swaps a part is a new revision.

types.name: DesignArtifact
types.title: Design artifacts
types.body:
## Design artifacts

A design file for a physical component: a 3D model, a PCB project, fabrication outputs or a drawing. The record names the format and the exact design it pins (`designKey`: a content hash, or a repository path and commit); the file itself lives in a repository linked with `source_in` or at a stored URL.

Use `design_of` for the PhysicalComponent it describes. A revision that includes the component pins the design through the artifact's `designKey`.

## For agents

A design artifact is design intent until a manufactured part and bench evidence exist. Never change its `designKey` in place; a changed design is a new artifact.

properties.name: format
properties.description: File format: STEP, STL, KiCad, Gerber or drawing.

properties.name: design_key
properties.description: Exact design identity: a content hash, or repository path@commit of the design files.

properties.name: url
properties.description: Where the file is stored when it is not in a linked repository.

types.name: design_of
types.title: design of
types.body: The source DesignArtifact describes the target PhysicalComponent. One component may have several artifacts (a model, its drawing, its PCB outputs).

types.name: TelemetryStream
types.title: Telemetry streams
types.body:
## Telemetry streams

A stream of measurements a device sends: what carries it (`transport`), the shape of each message (`schema`) and how often it arrives (`interval`).

Use `streams_from` for the PhysicalComponent that produces it and `measures` for each MetricDefinition it feeds. A project that ingests the stream links `collects_telemetry_from`.

## For agents

A stream record is a contract, not proof of data flowing. Keep received observations and their evidence separate from the definition.

properties.name: transport
properties.description: How messages travel, for example serial, BLE, LoRa, MQTT or HTTPS.

properties.name: schema
properties.description: Message shape: field names, units and encoding, or a reference to the schema file.

properties.name: interval
properties.description: How often a message is sent, for example every 60 s or on change.

types.name: streams_from
types.title: streams from
types.body: The source TelemetryStream is produced by the target PhysicalComponent.

types.name: measures
types.title: measures
types.body: The source TelemetryStream carries observations for the target MetricDefinition. The definition explains the measurement; the stream is where its values come from.

nodes.title: Design concept
nodes.summary: A Document of concept mockup images showing what a product revision is expected to look like, attached to that revision as evidence.
